property_summary: For any actor and any amount, after depositing amount the actor can successfully withdraw their full balance (the nonReentrant guard allows entry), leaving getBalance(actor) == 0; the mutant's inverted guard makes withdrawBalance always revert, so the withdrawal fails and the assertion breaks.
change_summary: Invert the guard condition to require(locked_), making all guarded calls revert so the balance is never credited or cleared as in the original.
